title: Price Reactions to Rivals’ Local Channel Exits
authors: O. Cem Ozturk; Sriram Venkataraman; Pradeep K. Chintagunta
eligible_reason: Treatment is a count of Chrysler dealership closings within 30 miles (ncl30t takes values 0-3 in the shipped data; spatial-heterogeneity columns use counts in 0-10/10-20/20-30 mile bands), not a binary indicator, and every specification adds time-varying controls (time since listed and its square, ZIP population and income, number of local competitors) and car (limited-VIN) FE alongside dealer, model x month and DMA x month FE. The Chrysler closures were announced on a single date (2009). The shipped data are synthetic.
design_notes: Car-listing-level price regression: proc glm lprice = dealerid modeldateid dmadateid tsl tslsq zip_pop zip_hhinc ncl30t, absorb(limvinid) [Table 3/7 spec 8]; Table 6 spec 1 adds num_loc_comp, ncl10 ncl20 ncl30 and a dealer x month trend dummy (dlrdate82).
data_files_note: README: 'Replication_data, a synthetic data set based on a slice of the Chrysler estimation data'.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available; screened from README, SAS code, shipped synthetic data and OpenAlex abstract.
